newsitem.title: UK: Montgomerie to take over as Venton underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Montgomerie to take over as Venton underwriter.

text.p: Richard Montgomerie is to replace Jeremy Venton as active underwriter on Lloyd's syndicate 376/2376 from April next year.
Venton, who has been active underwriter on syndicate 376 since 1982, had always intended to retire from active underwriting at age 50, Venton Underwriting Agencies said in a statement.

Venton Underwriting Agencies has Lloyd's insurance capacity of 225 million stg for 1997, making it one of the larger managing agencies in the insurance market, which has total capacity of 10.3 billion stg.
Jeremy Venton will retain a senior position within the group.
Montgomerie's appointment is subject to Lloyd's approval.
